summary: Ituran Location and Control Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing its second quarter 2026 earnings release and a scheduled conference call for August 12, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is involved. This is a routine quarterly earnings announcement and meeting notice. The registrant is the issuer providing an operational update to shareholders. There are no deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics to analyze. This filing does not constitute a special situation.
